name: Shinchi (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Shinchi town emblem in white: a stylised letter G with wing-like strokes at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Shinchi, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1971.

features.role: Shinchi town emblem — a stylised letter G with wing-like strokes at the fly
